name: Enbridge Inc
summary: Enbridge Inc. operates as a leading energy infrastructure enterprise with a diverse portfolio organized across five primary business segments. Its Liquids Pipelines division oversees an extensive network of pipelines and associated terminals, facilitating the transport of various crude oil grades and other liquid hydrocarbons throughout Canada and the United States. The Gas Transmission and Midstream segment focuses its investments on natural gas pipelines and crucial gathering and processing facilities in both Canadian and American regions. Serving residential, commercial, and industrial clients in Ontario, the Gas Distribution and Storage segment manages natural gas utility operations, in addition to gas distribution and transportation activities within Quebec. Through its Renewable Power Generation arm, Enbridge operates power-producing assets, including wind, solar, geothermal, and waste heat recovery installations, alongside transmission infrastructure across North America and Europe. Finally, the Energy Services segment provides comprehensive energy marketing services to refiners, producers, and other customers, complemented by physical commodity marketing and logistical support across Canada and the United States. Established in 1949, the company adopted its current name, Enbridge Inc., in October 1998, having previously been known as IPL Energy Inc. Its corporate headquarters are located in Calgary, Canada.
